Example inputs for plot_sv_linear()

Source: R/data.R
ex_plot_inputs.Rd

The same episomal EGFR ecDNA as ex_caller_inputs, expressed in the data-frame format expected by plot_sv_linear() for sample "EXAMPLE01". karyotype and gene_coord are omitted so the plotter falls back to the bundled hg38 references.

Usage

ex_plot_inputs

Format

A named list of three data.frames:

cnv_data

Copy-number segments; columns sample, seqnames, start, end, copyNumber, ploidy, majorAlleleCopyNumber, minorAlleleCopyNumber.

sv_data

Structural variants; columns chrom1, start1, chrom2, start2, strand1, strand2, svclass, VF, JCN, sample.

wgd_data

Whole-genome-duplication status; columns sample, Polyploidy.

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R.

See also

plot_sv_linear(), ex_caller_inputs

Examples

p <- plot_sv_linear(
  sample   = "EXAMPLE01",
  cnv_data = ex_plot_inputs$cnv_data,
  sv_data  = ex_plot_inputs$sv_data,
  wgd_data = ex_plot_inputs$wgd_data,
  chromosome = "chr7"
)
